about.heroDesc: Kariv Glamour is an independent luxury watch e-commerce platform connecting collectors with authenticated timepieces from the world's most iconic manufacturers. We believe acquiring a luxury watch should be as exceptional as the timepiece itself.
about.storyP1: Kariv Glamour was born from a simple observation: acquiring an authenticated luxury watch should be straightforward, transparent, and enjoyable. Too often, collectors face uncertainty about authenticity, opaque pricing, and impersonal service.
about.storyP2: Our platform brings together the finest new, pre-owned, vintage, and collector watches, each inspected and authenticated by our team of horological experts. From the iconic Omega Speedmaster to a rare Patek Philippe Grand Complication, we curate watches that tell stories.
about.storyP3: Based in Prague, Czech Republic, Kariv Glamour brings watch discovery and product information together in one online marketplace.
about.v1Desc: Every timepiece undergoes rigorous authentication by our team of certified horological experts before joining our collection.
about.v2Desc: Detailed condition assessments, comprehensive photography, and honest descriptions ensure you know exactly what you're acquiring.
about.v3Desc: We curate only the finest examples of each reference, maintaining the highest standards for quality and provenance.
about.v4Desc: Our dedicated team of watch specialists provides personalized guidance throughout your acquisition journey.
about.v5Desc: Worldwide insured shipping with white-glove service, ensuring your timepiece arrives safely wherever you are.
about.v6Desc: Founded by collectors for collectors, our passion for fine watchmaking drives every decision we make.

authentication.heroDesc: Every timepiece at Kariv Glamour undergoes our rigorous multi-stage authentication process. We never compromise on authenticity — your trust is our priority.
authentication.s1Desc: Every timepiece begins with a thorough visual inspection of the case, dial, hands, bezel, and crown for authenticity and condition.
authentication.s2Desc: Our certified watchmakers open and inspect the movement, verify caliber, serial numbers, and confirm all components are genuine and original.
authentication.s3Desc: We verify all accompanying documents including original papers, certificates, service history, and provenance.
authentication.s4Desc: Each watch receives a transparent condition grade — from New to Vintage — with detailed photography of every aspect.
authentication.s5Desc: Watches that pass our inspection receive the Kariv Glamour Authentication Certification, your guarantee of authenticity.
authentication.noFakesDesc: Kariv Glamour has a strict zero-tolerance policy for fake, replica, or counterfeit watches. Every watch on our platform is guaranteed 100% authentic. We use brand and model names solely to identify genuine products.

hero.title: Kariv Buyer Protection
hero.description: Buy your next luxury watch with confidence. Kariv Buyer Protection helps secure your payment, protect your order, verify seller standards, and support you throughout the entire purchase journey.

included.title: What’s Included in Kariv Buyer Protection?

items.title: Payment via Escrow Service
items.text: Your payment is securely held until your watch is delivered and you have time to inspect it.

items.title: Commitment to Authenticity
items.text: Every listed watch must be authentic. Dealers are required to list only original timepieces.

items.title: 14-Day Global Money-Back Guarantee
items.text: If the watch is defective, not as described, or does not meet the agreed listing details, you can start a return within 14 days after delivery.

items.title: Strict Dealer Guidelines
items.text: Dealers must follow Kariv Glamour’s marketplace rules and verification requirements before selling.

items.title: Insured Shipments
items.text: Orders must be shipped with insurance and tracking to help protect both domestic and international purchases.

items.title: Kariv Quality & Security Team
items.text: Our support and security team reviews issues, monitors suspicious activity, and assists buyers throughout the purchase process.

steps.title: Choose Your Watch
steps.text: Browse luxury watches from trusted sellers and review important details such as brand, model, reference number, condition, year, box and papers, service history, price, and shipping information.

steps.title: Pay Securely Through Kariv
steps.text: When your order is eligible for Kariv Escrow, your payment is held securely instead of being released immediately to the seller.

steps.title: Seller Ships the Watch
steps.text: The seller ships the watch using an insured shipping method with tracking. Shipment details are added to your order so you can follow the delivery.

steps.title: Inspect Your Watch
steps.text: After delivery, you have time to inspect the watch, compare it with the product listing, and confirm that the condition, documents, and accessories match the description.

steps.title: Seller Receives Payment
steps.text: Only after the buyer protection period has passed, or after the order is confirmed, is the payment released to the seller.

steps.title: Support Is Available
steps.text: If something is wrong, Kariv Glamour support helps guide the next steps, including return, refund, or dispute review where applicable.

escrow.title: Payment via the Kariv Escrow Service
escrow.intro: Thanks to the Kariv Escrow Service, eligible payments are held securely while your order is being completed. Instead of paying the seller directly, your payment is kept in a protected escrow account during the delivery and inspection period. This gives you time to receive your watch, check its condition, and confirm that the order matches the listing.
escrow.highlight: Your money is not released to the seller immediately. It remains protected during the buyer inspection period.
points: Payment is held securely during the transaction.
Buyer has 14 days after delivery to inspect the watch.
Seller payout is released only after the buyer protection conditions are satisfied.
Escrow applies only to eligible orders processed through Kariv Glamour’s checkout.

escrow.importantText: Kariv Buyer Protection only applies to eligible purchases completed through Kariv Glamour’s approved checkout and payment process. Payments made outside the platform may not be covered.

authenticity.title: Commitment to Authenticity
authenticity.intro: Kariv Glamour is committed to offering authentic luxury watches only. Every dealer and seller must list original timepieces and provide accurate product information. Product listings should clearly state the brand, model, reference number, condition, year, box and papers status, service history, and any known replacement or non-original parts.

Suspicious listings may be reviewed, hidden, or removed
authenticity.notice: Kariv Glamour does not allow counterfeit, replica, or intentionally misleading watch listings.
authenticity.counterfeitTitle: How We Help Protect Against Counterfeits
authenticity.counterfeitIntro: Luxury watches require trust. Kariv Glamour uses seller standards, product information checks, customer reporting, and support review to reduce the risk of counterfeit or misleading listings.

moneyBack.title: 14-Day Global Money-Back Guarantee
moneyBack.intro: If your watch is defective, malfunctioning, not as described, missing agreed accessories, or materially different from the product listing, you can contact Kariv Glamour support within 14 days after delivery to start a return request.

returnSteps.title: Contact Kariv Support
returnSteps.text: Email or message our support team within 14 days after receiving your watch. Include your order number, photos, and a clear explanation of the issue.

returnSteps.title: Return the Watch Safely
returnSteps.text: Once the return is approved, ship the watch back fully insured, with tracking, and in its original packaging, including all accessories, documents, tags, links, box, papers, and certificates received.

returnSteps.title: Receive Your Refund
returnSteps.text: After the return is received and checked, Kariv Glamour processes the refund according to the buyer protection and return policy terms.

items.a: Kariv Buyer Protection is designed to help customers buy luxury watches safely through Kariv Glamour. It includes secure payment handling, authenticity standards, dealer rules, insured shipping, support assistance, and a 14-day return request window for eligible orders.

items.q: How does the Kariv Escrow Service work?
items.a: For eligible orders, the buyer’s payment is held securely while the watch is shipped and inspected. The seller is paid only after the buyer protection conditions are satisfied.

items.q: How long do I have to inspect my watch?
items.a: You have 14 days after delivery to inspect the watch and contact Kariv Glamour support if the order is defective, not as described, or has another covered issue.

items.q: Are all watches on Kariv Glamour authentic?
items.a: Kariv Glamour requires sellers to list only authentic watches. Counterfeit and replica watches are not allowed. If an authenticity concern arises, buyers should contact support within the protection period.

items.q: What happens if the watch is not as described?
items.a: Contact Kariv Glamour support within 14 days after delivery. Provide your order number, photos, and a clear explanation of the issue. Our team will review the case and guide the return or resolution process.
Eligible sellers are required to ship watches with tracking and insurance. This helps protect buyers in rare cases of loss, theft, or unsuccessful delivery.
In most cases, the buyer may be responsible for return shipping unless the return is due to seller error, misdescription, or another covered issue. Return instructions will be provided by support.

items.q: What should I keep after receiving the watch?
items.a: Keep the original packaging, shipping materials, box, papers, warranty card, certificate, links, tags, service documents, and all accessories until you are certain you are keeping the watch.

items.q: Does Buyer Protection apply if I pay the seller directly?
items.a: No. Buyer Protection applies only to eligible transactions completed through Kariv Glamour’s approved checkout and payment process. Direct payments outside the platform may not be covered.

items.q: Can I return a watch because I changed my mind?
items.a: Return eligibility depends on the product, seller terms, jurisdiction, and Kariv Glamour policy. The 14-day money-back guarantee is designed mainly to protect buyers when an item is defective, not as described, or affected by a covered issue.

items.q: What happens if the package arrives damaged?
items.a: Document the damage immediately with photos and contact Kariv Glamour support. Keep all packaging and do not discard any shipping materials until the case is reviewed.

items.q: What if I suspect the watch is counterfeit?
items.a: Contact Kariv Glamour support immediately within the protection period. Provide photos, documents, and details about your concern. Kariv Glamour does not allow counterfeit or replica listings.
